BL-1370 — The per-pass orphan check is a gate with no tool: every orphan mechanism in the repo is a daemon sweep library, so each role hand-runs pgrep, hand-scopes it away from other worktrees, and hand-words the result 326 times over
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 by the specifier on the operator's direction: "another case
to move into the deterministic camp: killing orphan processes", with a QA
pane showing `sleep 15; ps -o pid,pgid,etimes,cmd -p 7759,7992` mid-pass.
Approval context: No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. The remedy's shape is fixed by an existing prompt requirement and an existing classifier. . What to know before approving.
